source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

data.summary: Low walls and barricades are examples of Light Terrain. Light features can shelter models from attacks without slowing their movement. See [Terrain and Movement](vsdata:core-rule/terrain-and-movement) for how models cross them and **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)** for when a target qualifies. An area with a light feature is [Obscuring](vsdata:core-rule/obscuring).

movement.contrast: dense features restrict some models (2" height limit)

routes.condition: every model is INFANTRY, BEASTS or SWARM within a terrain area
not fully visible to the attacking model because of terrain features or Obscuring

cover.exposedOnlyAreaMeetsAreaRoute: literal reading of 13.08; 13.03 carries no cover wording
